“再过几日收集到足够的民俗材料后，便可以想办法重新经营鸡舍了。”
菜地也不能够废弃。
尽量在生活上做到自给自足，可以减少很多负担。
沈易打定主意，回到院子里继续练蛮牛功。
……
近黄昏时刻。
黑山外围。
由几名大人带队，领着一伙半大少年从山中走出，朝着村子的方向兴致热烈而归。
他们身着兽皮，手上提着大弓，腰间挂着短刀，筋肉分明，每个人皆是全副武装。
显然是一支外出狩猎归来的队伍。
“哈哈哈，今天的收获真大啊，竟真让我们猎到了一头野猪妖。”
“虽说只是刚刚化妖，但能够拿下已是十分不易，值得庆贺！”
“这次功劳最大的当数是小宇和阿宁这两个娃子，小宇一人牵制住野猪妖的逃窜路线，阿宁则是找准时机完成致命一击，不愧是咱们黑山村的天才！”
带队的三名中年壮汉目光落在队伍里面的两名少年身上，眼中难掩赞赏之色。
“陈叔，你们过奖了。”
刘宇笑了笑，他看向身边的廖宁，道：“主要还是阿宁及时出手击杀了野猪妖，否则我还真不一定能够挡得住想要逃跑的野猪妖。”
一旁的少女脸色平静，“我们既然加入了狩猎队，自然是要尽一切手段去猎杀猎物，这是应该做的。”
“行了，你们的表现我们几位叔伯都看在眼里，等你们到了气血境三重，我们就提你们两个进狩猎一队。”
黑山村的狩猎队有着三支，其中的狩猎一队，是专门负责猎杀妖兽的。

危险系数极高！
想要加入进去，除了要达到足够的境界之外，还需要考验心性和胆量。
否则即便是实力够了，但是没有从容应对妖兽的心态，很快便会葬身兽口。
狩猎一队考核严格，相应的，能够加入其中的话，待遇自然是村里面最好的！
至少每次猎杀到妖兽，狩猎一队的成员都会分到不少妖兽肉，妖兽肉的效果会让他们的修炼速度加快很多！
听到他们能够加入狩猎一队，刘宇和廖宁眼中都不由得流露出一丝火热。
很快，众人回到了黑山村。
在经过村子的一角时，忽然有一个少年看向村子边缘的一栋院子，不经意地随口提了一句：
“诶？沈云叔家的木屋没倒啊。”
随着他的话音落下。
其他人的脸色都有所动容。
一般情况，刻在屋子上面用于抵御黑夜精怪的灵纹，在精怪每天晚上的侵蚀之下，只能够维持一个多月时间。
所以村子里的每一间木屋，是每个月都需要修缮一次的。
这样才能够保证木屋的灵纹效果不失效，避免被精怪摧毁屋子，将屋子里的人吞食掉。
算下时间，他们记得沈云的屋子已经有一个月未曾修缮过了。
待抵御精怪的灵纹失效后，这间屋子很快便会被夜晚里的精怪踏平。
“听说，两天前沈云叔的大儿子沈易外出打猎，结果遇到了一头几近化妖的野猪，好不容易重伤逃回，情况不容乐观。”
刘宇开口说道，顿了顿，看了廖宁一眼，继续说：

"After collecting enough folklore materials in a few days, we can find a way to run the chicken coop again."
The vegetable plot cannot be abandoned.
Trying to be self-sufficient in life can reduce a lot of burdens.
Shen Yi made up his mind and returned to the yard to continue practicing the Barbarian Ox Kung Fu.
…
Near dusk.
Outskirts of Montenegro.
Led by several adults, a group of half-grown teenagers walked out of the mountains and returned in the direction of the village with great interest.
They were dressed in animal skins, holding large bows in their hands, and daggers hanging from their waists. Their muscles were well defined, and each of them was fully armed.
Apparently they were a team returning from a hunting trip.
"Hahaha, today's harvest is really great. We actually hunted a wild boar demon."
"Although I have just transformed into a demon, it is already very difficult to win, and it is worth celebrating!"
"The two children who deserve the greatest credit this time are Xiaoyu and Aning. Xiaoyu alone restrained the wild boar demon's escape route, while Aning found the right moment to deliver the fatal blow. He is truly the genius of our Black Mountain Village!"
The three middle-aged burly men leading the team cast their eyes on the two young men in the team, with admiration in their eyes.
"Uncle Chen, you have given me a reward."
Liu Yu smiled. He looked at Liao Ning beside him and said, "The main thing is that Aning killed the wild boar demon in time. Otherwise, I might not be able to stop the wild boar demon that wanted to escape."
The girl on the side looked calm, "Since we have joined the hunting team, we must use all means to hunt the prey. This is what we should do."
"Okay, our uncles have seen your performance. When you reach the third level of Qi and Blood Realm, we will put you two into the hunting team."
There are three hunting teams in Heishan Village, and the first hunting team is specifically responsible for hunting monsters.
The risk factor is extremely high!
If you want to join, in addition to reaching a sufficient level, you also need to test your character and courage.
Otherwise, even if you have enough strength, but do not have the mentality to deal with monsters calmly, you will soon be killed by the beast.
The hunting team has strict assessments, and accordingly, if you can join it, the treatment will naturally be the best in the village!
At least every time a monster is hunted, the members of the hunting team will get a lot of monster meat. The effect of the monster meat will speed up their cultivation a lot!
Hearing that they could join the hunting team, Liu Yu and Liao Ning couldn't help but show a hint of fire in their eyes.
Soon, everyone returned to Heishan Village.
While passing through a corner of the village, a young man suddenly looked at a courtyard on the edge of the village and casually mentioned:
"Eh? Uncle Chen Yun's wooden house didn't collapse."
As his words fell.
The expressions on other people's faces were moved.
Under normal circumstances, the spiritual patterns carved on the house to resist the night spirits can only last for more than a month due to the erosion of the spirits every night.
Therefore, every wooden house in the village needs to be repaired every month.
This can ensure that the spiritual pattern effect of the wooden house does not expire, and prevents the spirit from destroying the house and devouring the people in the house.
Counting the time, they remembered that Shen Yun's house had not been repaired for a month.
After the spiritual pattern that resists the spirits fails, this room will soon be trampled by the spirits at night.
"I heard that Uncle Shen Yun's eldest son Shen Yi went out hunting two days ago. As a result, he encountered a wild boar that almost turned into a demon. He finally escaped with serious injuries. The situation is not optimistic."
